**YouTube Description:**

Hi everyone and welcome back to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge*! I’m your host, **Bethany Gifford**, and after over a decade managing surgeons, teams, and practices in dermatology and plastic surgery, I now work with leaders across aesthetics, health, and wellness to uncover growth opportunities and help practices scale smarter, not harder.  

In this episode, I’m joined by **Jim Donnelly**, founder of **Humanaut** — a cutting-edge health optimization and integrated wellness ecosystem headquartered in Austin, Texas, now expanding into Florida and Dallas.  

Jim and I explore how Humanaut is redefining preventative medicine and turning health optimization into a movement. We dive into what makes their model so different from traditional clinics, including their use of AI-driven diagnostics, regenerative medicine, and community-based wellness that empowers clients to truly “live like a human.”  

You’ll learn about:  
• How Humanaut integrates diagnostics, regenerative treatments, and personalized plans into one seamless experience  
• The role of **AI and data** in modern wellness and patient care  
• Why health optimization is **not a trend** — it’s the future of healthcare  
• The importance of **community, agency, and accountability** in achieving long-term vitality  
• The mission behind adding **20 years of good living** to every client’s life  

If you’ve ever wondered how to integrate wellness, technology, and regenerative medicine into your practice — or simply how to take ownership of your own health — this episode is a must-listen.  

📍 Learn more: [https://humanauthealth.com](https://humanauthealth.com)  
🔗 Connect with Jim Donnelly on LinkedIn  
🎧 Subscribe to *The Aesthetic & Wellness Edge* for more conversations bridging aesthetics, medicine, and the business of human potential.  

#AestheticAndWellnessEdge #BethanyGifford #HumanautHealth #HealthOptimization #RegenerativeMedicine #Longevity #AIInHealthcare #FunctionalWellness #PreventativeMedicine #Biohacking #AestheticMedicine
